title: Squat: Quant Small Language Models on the Edge
evidence_span: IV-B/E: attention distillation, token precision and SIMD kernels; V-A/B: evaluation; Tables I-IV: accuracy and latency.
problem: Sub-byte quantization must preserve attention information and map to commodity SIMD execution.
method_or_artifact: Entropy/distribution-guided QAT, attention-ranked 4/8-bit token precision, and mixed-precision SIMD multiplication.
hardware_or_process_assumptions: OnePlus 11 Snapdragon 8 Gen 2, all cores; Raspberry Pi 5 BCM2712, four cores. Latency: 1000 iterations, 128 input tokens, ms/token.
limits: Speedup is not iso-accuracy improvement. Two PDF ratios are rounding-incompatible; one further difference is rounding-compatible. Warmup, thermal controls and prefill/decode boundary unresolved. No measured on-device training established. See supplementary assessment; no independent acceptance.

evidence_locators.location: V-B; Table IV, PDF page 9; supplementary PDF rounding analysis
